Name: (SVE) Stardew Valley Expanded Companions - NPC Adventures-unofficial-mardrest
Author: mardrest
Description:
This adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] NPC's (created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] ) to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582?tab=description]It's Time to Adventure (NPC Adventures)[/url]﻿ mod (created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68185132]PurrplingCat[/url]﻿).

Each NPC was given unique companion dialogue and combat phrases, although
the dialogue is very much a WIP and will be expanded upon. I tried to
stick to each of their characters and archetypes, but this dialogue was
not created by FlashShifter and may not be considered cannon. I also
created some new sprites for Andy, Marlon, Olivia, and Susan so that
each character would have more than 1 idle animation.

This mod is meant to be played with the version 1.0.2 of the NPC Adventures mod.
[b]

*This uses the sprites from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4648]Slightly Cuter Sprites for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url]﻿ mod.[/b]
